market_view: Healthcare is seeing mixed action today with broader defensive pharma pulling back after recent multi-week runs. Earnings reactions dominate the tape, with strong underlying demand lifting Thermo Fisher and fueling an aggressive intraday recovery in Intuitive Surgical following initial post-earnings selling. We remain selective, leaning into high-quality growth names showing strong fundamental catalysts and buying support.

decisions.reason: Intuitive Surgical beat Q3 expectations and raised procedure guidance, and after an initial dip to $399.68, shares have surged over 6% from open with fresh price target boosts from JP Morgan ($475), Barclays ($500), and Baird ($550).

experiment: Testing post-earnings dip-reversal momentum on robotic surgical/med-tech leaders with raised guidance and multiple Tier-1 analyst upgrades.
